#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int countDistinct(const std::vector<int>& array, int start, int end) {
    bool seen[24] = {false};
    int total = 0;
    for (int i = start; i <= end; i++) {
        int c = array[i];
        if (!seen[c]) {
            seen[c] = true;
            total++;
        }
    }
    return total;
}

int main() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    std::cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;
    l -= 1;
    r -= 1;

    int totalAB = a + b;
    int repetitions = 4;
    std::vector<int> cc(totalAB * repetitions, 0);

    int blockIndex = l / totalAB;
    l -= blockIndex * totalAB;
    r -= blockIndex * totalAB;

    int blockCount = (r - l + 1) / totalAB;
    if (blockCount > 2) {
        r -= (blockCount - 2) * totalAB;
    }

    int diff = (a > b) ? (a - b) : 1;

    for (int h = 0; h < repetitions; h++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < a - diff; k++)
            cc[(a + b) * h + k] = k;
        for (int k = 0; k < diff; k++)
            cc[(a + b) * h + a - diff + k] = (h % 2 == 0) ? a - diff + k : a + k;
    }

    int minCount = a + a;
    for (int k0 = 1; k0 <= diff; k0++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < b; k++)
            cc[(a + b) * 0 + a + k] = cc[(a + b) * 0 + a - k0];
        for (int k1 = 1; k1 <= diff; k1++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < b; k++)
                cc[(a + b) * 1 + a + k] = cc[(a + b) * 1 + a - k1];
            for (int k2 = 1; k2 <= diff; k2++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < b; k++)
                    cc[(a + b) * 2 + a + k] = cc[(a + b) * 2 + a - k2];
                for (int k3 = 1; k3 <= diff; k3++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < b; k++)
                        cc[(a + b) * 3 + a + k] = cc[(a + b) * 3 + a - k3];
                    minCount = std::min(minCount, countDistinct(cc, l, r));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    std::cout << minCount << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
